name: Dish with Bird on Fruit Tree Branch
material: Porcelain with famille-verte overglaze enamel decoration
summary: Among the greatest achievements of early Qing porcelain are table wares and display objects decorated with polychrome painting like this pair of dishes. Featuring birds perched in peach trees, the dishes are related to the famous birthday set commissioned for the Kangxi emperor’s sixtieth birthday i
